I don't understand how the 'selling' part fits in. Do I subtract the 150?

Think about it this way: Paul bought 150 books, which increases his total. Selling books decreases his total. To find out how many he sold, you first need to determine how many books he would have had in total if he hadn't sold any at all.

Exactly. Now that you have the hypothetical total of 152, compare that to the 58 books he actually has now. The difference between those two numbers represents the books that left his collection during the sale.
